name: Lyo.Espn.Fantasy.Football.Client
tagline: Read-only typed client for ESPN's fantasy football v3 API (`lm-api-reads.fantasy.espn.com/apis/v3/games/ffl/`).
description: Read-only typed client for ESPN's fantasy football v3 API (`lm-api-reads.fantasy.espn.com/apis/v3/games/ffl/`). It subclasses `Lyo.Api.Client.ApiClient` so JSON serialization, Accept-Encoding, and request compression stay consistent with the rest of the Lyo HTTP-client family.

sections.title: Manager surface
rows: `GetAsync(leagueId, seasonId)` (settings + teams + standings), `GetTeamsAsync` (rosters for each scoring period), `GetTeamAsync` (one team), `GetDraftAsync` (draft picks), `GetMatchupsAsync` (scoreboard).

`GetLeagueChatAsync` (lists Fantasy Chat topics on `lm-api-communication`, then loads each conversation), `GetConversationAsync` (one topic; newest 25 messages by default), `GetRecentActivityAsync` (adds/drops/trades feed through `kona_league_communication`).
sections.lead: [`FantasyFootballClient`](FantasyFootballClient.cs) exposes four manager properties; seasons before **2018** are rejected (checked by `ValidateSeason`).
sections.trail:
URL composition, the `x-fantasy-filter` header, and cookie auth go through internal helpers `BuildLeaguePath`, `BuildCommunicationPath`, `GetLeagueViewAsync`, `GetCommunicationAsync`, and `ApplyAuthentication`. [`FantasyFilterReqBuilder`](Builders) builds the
`x-fantasy-filter` JSON per call (player ids, transaction types, recent activity windows). Chat list and conversation calls use `CommunicationBaseUrl` and append `platform=chat`.

Request types sit under [`Models/Request`](Models) (`PlayerInfoQuery`, `ChatConversationQuery`, `RecentActivityQuery`, `TransactionsQuery`, `FantasyFilterReq`); response types sit under `Models/Response`
(`LeagueRes`, `TeamRes`, `MatchupRes`, `DraftResponseRes`, `PlayerInfoItemRes`, `CommunicationTopicRes`, `TransactionRes`, `ChatConversationRes`, etc.).

sections.title: Settings ([`FantasyFootballClientOptions`](FantasyFootballClientOptions.cs))
rows: Optional `espn_s2` cookie value. Needed for **private leagues**.
Optional `SWID` cookie value. Needed for **private leagues**.
Fantasy Chat host root. Defaults to `https://lm-api-communication.fantasy.espn.com/apis/v3/games/ffl/`.
sections.lead:
Binds from section `FantasyFootballClient` (overrides the base `ApiClient` section). Picks up every
[`ApiClientOptions`](../../Api/Lyo.Api.Client/README.md#options-apiclientoptions) flag and adds:
sections.trail: `BaseUrl` defaults to `https://lm-api-reads.fantasy.espn.com/apis/v3/games/ffl/`. `CommunicationBaseUrl` defaults to the Fantasy Chat host. Public leagues skip cookies; both cookie values must be set before the client attaches them.

sections.title: Wire into DI ([`Extensions.cs`](Extensions.cs))
sections.trail: Every overload registers `FantasyFootballClient` as a singleton and takes `ILoggerFactory` plus any registered `HttpClient` from DI.
